note: Every relationship row in RUT 4 agrees with the Hebrew: the Mahlon/Ruth husband and wife pair (4:10), Perez under Judah and Tamar (4:12), and the genealogy 4:18-22 from Perez to David. The owner row amminadab son-of ram (4:19, 'Ram begat Amminadab') matches the text, and 'a son born to Naomi' (4:17) is the women's figure of speech rather than a plain begetting, so no naomi mother-of obed row is listed.
